title: We Are Christians, Aren’t We? Let’s Focus on Jesus Christ
paragraphs: We Are Christians, Aren’t We? Let’s Focus on Jesus Christ

In a time when the world is filled with division, confusion, and distractions, it’s easy to lose sight of what it truly means to be a Christian. But let’s pause and ask ourselves: If we call ourselves Christians, shouldn’t we be focusing on the teachings of Jesus Christ?

The word “Christian” means follower of Christ. It’s not about political agendas, social status, or personal opinions—it’s about living a life that reflects Jesus. So, are we truly living as He taught us to live?

What Did Jesus Teach Us?
Jesus’ teachings are crystal clear and life-changing. Here are a few key principles that every Christian is called to follow:

1. Love Above All Else
Jesus said, “Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind… and love your neighbor as yourself” (Matthew 22:37-39).

Are we loving God fully?
Are we loving others unconditionally, even those who hurt us?
Love is not just a feeling; it’s an action. It means forgiving, helping, and serving.

2. Be Humble and Serve
Jesus washed His disciples’ feet, saying, “I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you” (John 13:15).

Are we serving others selflessly, as Jesus did?
Or are we more focused on our own comfort and status?
True greatness in God’s kingdom comes from humility and service.

3. Forgive and Let Go of Bitterness
Jesus taught us to forgive, saying, “For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you” (Matthew 6:14).

Are we holding onto grudges?
Or are we extending the same grace that God has shown us?
Forgiveness isn’t easy, but it’s essential for healing and unity.

4. Preach the Gospel
Jesus gave us the Great Commission: “Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit” (Matthew 28:19).

Are we sharing the good news of salvation?
Or are we keeping our faith to ourselves?
The world desperately needs hope, and we are called to share it.

A Call to Refocus
It’s time to get back to the basics of our faith. If we are Christians, we must live as Christ taught us to live:

Love unconditionally.
Serve humbly.
Forgive freely.
Share the gospel boldly.
Let’s stop getting distracted by things that divide us and focus on the one thing that unites us: Jesus Christ.

A Prayer for the Church
Heavenly Father,
Forgive us for the times we’ve lost sight of Your Son’s teachings. Help us to love as Jesus loved, serve as He served, and forgive as He forgave. Unite us as a body of believers and refocus our hearts on living out Your Word. Let the world see Jesus through us.
This message is a powerful reminder of our calling as Christians. Share it, live it, and let’s inspire others to refocus on the teachings of Jesus Christ. 🌍❤️
